newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells treasury bills worth $ 26.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells treasury bills worth $ 26.6 mln.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 550 million rupees (26.58 million dollars) worth of treasury bills at its weekly auction, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 103 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 9.02 percent at the Thursday auction, against 69.5 million rupees at 9.27 percent last week.
The bank sold 182-day bills worth 123 million rupees with an average yield of 9.03 percent, against 60 million rupees at 9.43 percent last week.
The bank sold 364-day bills worth 324 million rupees at an average yield of 9.35 percent, against 70.5 million rupees at 9.71 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 9.22 percent per annum from 9.47 percent last week, the bank said.
